criteria.name: Report Quality
criteria.body:
Assess the clarity, structure and quality of the written report.

| Band | Marks | Descriptor |
|------|-------|------------|
| Excellent | 5 | Clear, well-structured and professionally presented. |
| Good | 4 | Mostly clear with minor presentation issues. |
| Satisfactory | 3 | Adequate structure; some clarity issues. |
| Limited | 2 | Poorly structured or difficult to follow. |
| Minimal | 0–1 | Very little coherent written work. |

criteria.name: Use of AI
criteria.body:
Assess how effectively and critically the participant used AI tools throughout the task.

| Band | Marks | Descriptor |
|------|-------|------------|
| Excellent | 9–10 | Sophisticated, strategic use with clear reflection and iteration. |
| Good | 7–8 | Effective use with some evidence of critical evaluation. |
| Satisfactory | 5–6 | AI used but with limited reflection or strategic intent. |
| Limited | 3–4 | Basic or uncritical use of AI tools. |
| Minimal | 0–2 | Little evidence of meaningful AI engagement. |

criteria.name: Result / Product Quality
criteria.body:
Assess the quality and accuracy of the final output or product produced.

| Band | Marks | Descriptor |
|------|-------|------------|
| Excellent | 5 | High-quality, accurate and well-refined final product. |
| Good | 4 | Good quality with minor inaccuracies or omissions. |
| Satisfactory | 3 | Adequate quality; some errors or incomplete elements. |
| Limited | 2 | Below expectations; significant gaps or inaccuracies. |
| Minimal | 0–1 | Very limited or unsatisfactory final product. |
